summary: Bounded list declaration ownership/default/index correction follows the pinned sources and passes all unchanged mandatory gates.
findings: The old callback-owned XMLListStyleContext was removed. xmlnumi now owns source-ordered retained level contexts; invalid indices are skipped before property reads; native optional fields and byte-string parsing are covered independently and through ODT cycles.
residual_risks: No full-module promotion. Wider numbering/UNO/identity/global SAX null dispatch, layout and browser composition remain separate obligations; explicit unsupported families remain outstanding goal scope.
